Stories discussed in this episode:

  • iOS 27 adds opt-in setting to share data to help improve Apple's Foundation Models
  • iCloud+ now includes Apple TV and Apple Arcade for free in select countries
  • macOS 27 Golden Gate officially launches—here's everything new
